message: Capture package blocker isolated from exact #2805@4456c176874c7489d5f0789b51e56324205442e6 selective-graft artifact 9092226121: both normal `swift test` and diagnostic `swift test --no-parallel` terminate with Swift fatal `Range requires lowerBound <= upperBound`; `swift test list` succeeds and the standalone Capture Xcode build succeeds. Serial execution pinpoints the crash at suite `Capture primary rider language`, test `primary Capture flow stays rider-first while Engineering Details retains exact protocol truth`. Source `Packages/NembraBluetoothCapture/Tests/NembraBluetoothCaptureTests/TuyaCapturePrimaryLanguageSourceTests.swift` builds `primaryStart = app.range(of: "private var preflightPanel")` and independently `detailsStart = app.range(of: "private var engineeringDisclosure")`, then slices `app[primaryStart.lowerBound..<detailsStart.lowerBound]` without proving detailsStart follows primaryStart. Current source ordering makes that Range invalid and traps the whole test process. Repair the test boundary by locating Engineering Details only in `primaryStart.lowerBound..<app.endIndex` (or otherwise explicitly require ordered markers) while preserving all rider-language/truth assertions. This inherited deterministic test-harness defect explains broad Capture package rejection on current security/build/flagship lineages; do not misclassify it as #2805 helper-execution product failure. Re-run full package/Xcode/selective-graft on every moved exact head after repair. Physical remains NO-GO.
